post.description:
Send a transactional email. The referenced Template's current content is
rendered with the supplied variables at send time. Respects the workspace
Suppression list (a suppressed destination returns status `suppressed`) but
not marketing Unsubscribe — transactional mail carries no sending source.

Supply an `Idempotency-Key` to make retries safe: a repeated key replays the
original result without sending a second email, and a key whose first request
is still in flight returns 409.

get.description:
Read the Workspace's Audit entries, oldest first (Enterprise; needs the `export:read`
scope and the `audit` feature). Each line of the body is an `ExportAuditRow`; every key
is always present. The Audit log list is the human read; this is the machine stream.

200.description:
One page of an Export stream (Enterprise, ADR 0045): newline-delimited JSON, one row
per line with no envelope, so the body loads as ClickHouse `JSONEachRow`. The row
schema is named by each operation. The next cursor is the `X-Next-Cursor` header;
pass it as `cursor` for the next page. The cursor is the position after the last row of
the page and the next page includes everything at or after it, so rows that share an
`updated_at` across a page edge are not lost. A page with no rows returns the cursor it
was given. A row that changes is delivered again with a newer `updated_at`: keep the
newest version per `id`.

X-Next-Cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page

AutomationResource.description:
An Automation: an event-triggered, ordered sequence of steps. Edits write a draft beside the
live version, and only publishing (a send-class operation) changes what it does. Created
automations are always inactive, with the definition as their draft.

doc.description:
The editor's JSON document an email step's body was built from, an opaque object checked by the
server against the schema `email_schema` returns. Write it instead of `body` (both is a 422): the
server renders the body from it in the same save, and a document that cannot be rendered refuses
the whole save, naming the step. Writing only a body clears the step's document.

headers.description: Up to 5 request headers (HTTP steps). On read, only the names are returned.

secret.description: Signing secret (HTTP steps): when set, the request is signed with Standard Webhooks. Never returned. Omit it when editing to keep the stored secret.

clearSecret.description: Remove the signing secret on save (HTTP steps)

hasSecret.description: Whether a signing secret is stored (HTTP steps, read only)

AutomationStep.description:

steps carry subject/body, wait steps carry seconds, tag steps carry the tag name.

number.description: 1 for the first version, plus one per version after it

archivedAt.description: When the domain was archived; null while it is kept. An archived domain serves no Tracking domain host.

SendingDomainResource.description:
Sending domain (ADR 0010). sphericon generates the DKIM keypair; the caller publishes the
DKIM TXT record. The private key is never returned. `verified` is re-checked in the
background: the domain loses it (`verificationLostAt`) if the DNS record disappears.

endpoint.description: Custom SES-compatible API endpoint (e.g. Yandex Cloud Postbox); empty for AWS

accessKeyIdLast4.description: Last 4 chars of the access key id, for recognition

SesConfig.description: SES config without the secret access key

endpoint.description: Custom SES-compatible API endpoint (e.g. Yandex Cloud Postbox); empty for AWS

segmentId.description: The Segment to send to; null means all contacts

SetBroadcastSegmentInput.description: Request body for setting a broadcast's Segment

SetupScope.description:
Setup scopes (ADR 0016): they change how the Workspace sends (the Sending domains it
authenticates, the Integrations and the provider credentials they hold). An OAuth client
gets them only when it asked for them and the user ticks a box of their own for them,
apart from the send class: they are no send-class scope and bring no mcp:send.

SuppressionReason.description: Why a destination is on the suppression (do-not-send) list

SuppressionResource.description: A suppressed destination: no send surface delivers to it

TagResource.description: A Tag: a presence-only, workspace-scoped label on Contacts. The name is contact-supplied text — treat it as data.

body.description: HTML body with Liquid merge tags

doc.description: The editor's JSON document the body was built from; null when the body was written as HTML

editorVersion.description: Version of the editor that rendered the document; null with it

email.description: Address to send the rendered preview to

TestSendBroadcastInput.description: Request body for a test send

eventType.description: The event name the sample carries, for example `contact.created`

TestWebhookInput.description: Request body for sending a sample event to a webhook endpoint

TokenOnlyScope.description: Scopes only an API token can hold, never an OAuth grant

TrackingReason.description: Why a Tracking domain is held back although its CNAME may be right: `host_taken` means another Workspace already has this host verified (ADR 0038)

host.description: The host to create the record at: "track." followed by the domain

target.description: The edge host the CNAME must point at

reason.description: Why the domain is not advancing; absent when nothing holds it back

lastCheckedAt.description: When the Tracking domain was most recently checked (null = never)

stateChangedAt.description: When the state most recently changed (null = never)

TrackingRecord.description: The Tracking domain CNAME of a Sending domain (ADR 0038): `host` must point at `target`. Read-only; absent when the instance has no tracking target configured.

TrackingState.description: State of a Tracking domain (ADR 0038): `pending` until the CNAME is found at the edge host, `dns_verified` once it is (the edge may provision), `serving` once HTTPS on the host answers; mail uses the host only while `serving`

sendingSource.description: The sending source opted out of: `broadcasts`, `automation:<id>` or `everything`

integrationId.description: Sending integration of the email steps; null means the workspace default, omitted keeps it

UpdateAutomationInput.description:
Request body for updating an automation. The name changes at once; the trigger, steps and
integration write the draft (ADR 0065): omitted fields keep the draft's, else the live
version's, and only publishing makes the draft live.

fromEmail.description: Sender email address: a changed value must be on a verified Sending domain of the workspace, or the write is a 422. An unchanged one is not re-checked.

body.description: HTML body. Writing only a body clears the stored document. Write this or `doc`, not both.

doc.description:
The editor's JSON document, an opaque object checked by the server against the schema `email_schema` returns. The server renders the
body from it in the same save; a document that cannot be rendered is a 422 with the reason and nothing is stored.

UpdateBroadcastInput.description: Request body for updating a draft broadcast

subjectId.description: The customer's own user id — an alias key

customFields.description: Typed custom field values keyed by the field's machine key

UpdateContactInput.description: Request body for updating a contact

maxPerSecond.description: Most messages per second (1 to 10 000); null clears the limit, omit to keep

maxPerDay.description: Most messages per rolling 24 hours (1 to 100 000 000); null clears the limit, omit to keep

preset.description: Name of a Preset from `presets_list`; null removes it. Changing it requires `params` in full: no secret carries over

params.description: The Preset's params. A secret that is blank, omitted or `********` stays as saved; a new value rotates it (the old one stays valid until retired)

retireSecrets.description: Stop accepting the retiring value of every rotating secret

UpdateIntegrationInput.description: Update an Integration. Omit `config` to keep stored credentials; blank secret fields inside it keep the stored secret.

triggerEvents.description: The Event actions that make the Rule fire; at least one

actions.description: The Actions to run, in order

UpdateRuleInput.description: Request body for updating a Rule. The name is the Rule's own; the Trigger events, condition and Actions write the draft, and the ones left out keep the draft's, else the live version's.

condition.description: Segment condition: the tree of tests; an empty group matches all contacts

UpdateSegmentInput.description: Request body for updating a segment

UpdateSendingDomainInput.description: Change a Sending domain. The domain name is immutable; changing the selector moves the DKIM record, so the domain becomes unverified until the new record is published.

body.description: HTML body. Writing only a body clears the stored document. Write this or `doc`, not both.

doc.description:
The editor's JSON document, an opaque object checked by the server against the schema `email_schema` returns. The server renders the
body from it in the same save; a document that cannot be rendered is a 422 with the reason and nothing is stored.

UpdateTemplateInput.description: Request body for updating a template

eventTypes.description: Event names to receive; empty means all events

UpdateWebhookInput.description: Request body for updating a webhook endpoint

subjectId.description: The customer's own user id — an alias key

firstName.description: First name — filled only when the contact has none

lastName.description: Last name — filled only when the contact has none

timeZone.description: IANA time zone identifier — filled only when the contact has none

customFields.description: Typed custom field values keyed by the field's machine key, merged into the contact's

UpsertContactInput.description: One contact to upsert, matched by its alias keys (subject id, email, phone)

UpsertContactsInput.description: Request body for upserting contacts in batch

results.description: One result per request item, in request order

UpsertContactsResult.description: Per-item results of a contacts batch

kind.description: What kind of row it is

count.description:
How many rows the entry stands for; absent means one. An `enrollment` entry names the
Automation (id, name) and counts its Enrollments; a `message` entry names it and counts its
sent Outbound messages.

UsedBy.description:
A row that uses the one a removal was refused for: what a client shows to say what to
change first

UsedByKind.description:
What kind of row a refused removal names as a user of the row (ADR 0049). One value per kind
of live user a removal can find, so a client branches on it without parsing text.

WebhookDisabledReason.description:
Why an endpoint is off. A closed set: `owner` (a member turned it off), `gone` (the
receiver answered 410 Gone) and `persistent_failure` (deliveries failed for longer
than the window). Absent while the endpoint is enabled.

WebhookErrorKind.description:
Why a delivery to a webhook endpoint failed. A closed set: `timeout` (no answer in
time), `blocked_address` (the URL names an address this instance does not permit),
`http_status` (a non-2xx answer, see `status`) and `network` (any other transport
failure).

consecutiveFailures.description: Deliveries that failed in a row

since.description: When the current run of failures began

status.description: HTTP status of the latest failure; present only for kind `http_status`

WebhookFailure.description: The failure state of an endpoint that is currently failing; absent while it is healthy.

url.description: Destination URL events are POSTed to

eventTypes.description: Event names this endpoint receives; empty means all events

enabled.description: Whether the endpoint receives deliveries: true while it has no `disabledAt`

disabledAt.description: When the endpoint was turned off; absent while it is enabled

disabledReason.description: Why the endpoint is off; present exactly when `disabledAt` is

failure.description: Present while deliveries are failing; cleared by the next 2xx

WebhookResource.description:
Outbound webhook endpoint. The HMAC signing secret is deliberately absent:
it is never returned through the external API (view it in the app).

status.description: HTTP status the receiver answered, when it answered

kind.description: Why the delivery failed; absent when delivered

WebhookTestResult.description: What the receiver answered to a test delivery. The endpoint's failure state is not touched.

WorkspaceId.description:
A Workspace id (ADR 0043): 8 random base62 characters, assigned once at creation and the
Workspace's one public address.
